terra.problem: The passage does not say the storm had lasted two weeks or that nobody knew what the land would mean for them.
The passage does not say they had been in a storm for fourteen nights. It also does not say what the sailors were thinking when they took soundings.
Shallower soundings do not necessarily establish that land is close. The passage does not say that the soundings told the sailors this.
The passage does not say the shallower water meant they were closer to land or that this was why they got nervous.
The passage does not say the sailors had no other way to leave or that everyone stayed aboard after the lifeboat was set adrift.
The passage does not say nobody used the lifeboat after it was set adrift.
The passage does not say the storm had lasted fourteen days.
The passage says everyone was encouraged and ate, but does not say they had been frozen or that watching Paul eat was all the push they needed.
The passage does not say how much grain there was or that it sank.
The passage says they hoisted the foresail, but it does not establish that no other sail went anywhere.
The passage does not state that they loosened the rudder ropes so they could steer toward the beach.
The passage does not say what everyone aboard knew about whether the plan would work.
The passage does not say how close the ship got to the beach.
The sailors are not mentioned in this moment, but the passage does not say they were not part of it.
The centurion commanded those who could swim to go first. The passage does not call them strong swimmers or explicitly narrate their departure in that order.
Papa Dorin uses his mustache as hands. He should not say he would hold on with both hands.
The passage mentions planks and various parts of the ship, but does not say there were plenty of pieces.
